title: PUBG developer Krafton plans to invest $250M in India over three to four years, for a total investment of $500M+ since 2021, as it expands into AI and robotics (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: PUBG developer Krafton plans to invest $250M in India over three to four years, for a total investment of $500M+ since 2021, as it expands into AI and robotics — Krafton, the South Korean gaming company behind titles including PUBG and Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) …
